description: This PHP file defines functions related to rendering and managing interactive ad layer styles, specifically for geocities-style layers, including capabilities detection, JavaScript code generation for layer positioning and visibility toggling, and HTML generation for ad layers.

methods.name: MAX_layerGetLimitations
methods.description: Returns capabilities related to rich media and browser compatibility based on global client info.

methods.name: MAX_layerPutJs
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for positioning and managing ad layers, including show/hide and collapse/expand functionality.

methods.name: MAX_layerGetHtml
methods.description: Generates HTML code for displaying ad layers with controls and content.
